meaning:
ἀφόβως
adv. (φόβος), [in LXX: Pro.1:33 (פַּחַד), Wis.17:4 * ;]
without fear: Luk.1:74, Php.1:14, 1Co.16:10, Ju 12.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: to grant to us that we, being delivered out of the hand of our enemies, should serve him without fear,
Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear, for he does the work of the Lord, as I also do.
and that most of the brothers in the Lord, being confident through my bonds, are more abundantly bold to speak the word of God without fear.
These are hidden rocky reefs in your love feasts when they feast with you, shepherds who without fear feed themselves; clouds without water, carried along by…
